=== NES ROM Metadata (iNES Format) ===
PRG ROM (Code/Data): 16 banks x 16KB (262144 bytes)
CHR ROM (Graphics) : 32 banks x 8KB (262144 bytes)
Mapper Number      : 4
Mirroring          : Horizontal
Battery RAM (Save) : Yes
Trainer Present    : No
======================================

=== CHR-ROM (Graphics) Reference ===
The graphics payload has been excluded from the hex dump to save tokens.
Instead, it has been provided to you as an image file: mother_sprites.png

To modify a specific graphic tile, use the following formula to find its address:
- CHR-ROM Start Offset in ROM : 0x00040010
- Image Grid Layout           : 16 tiles per row
- Bytes per Tile              : 16 bytes (8x8 pixels, 2bpp NES format)

Formula: Address = 0x00040010 + (Row_Index * 16 + Column_Index) * 16
(Note: Row and Column indices start at 0 from the top-left of the image)
